description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payble to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a special allowance for workers in specific agricultural trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It falls under public service administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions in specific employment sectors, issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance. This constitutes public sector service administration rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
